title: Evaluating Gemini LLM in Food Image-Based Recipe and Nutrition Description with EfficientNet-B4 Visual Backbone

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the visual classification accuracy and generative text quality of a decoupled multimodal pipeline (EfficientNet-B4 + Gemini LLM) on a newly created Custom Chinese Food Dataset (CCFD). This aims to address and quantify the performance gap caused by cultural bias in existing, widely-used Western-centric datasets like Food-101.
